functions.desc: Execute SQL on a range. Table = 'data'. Example: SELECT Name, SUM(Amount) FROM data GROUP BY Name

args.name: sql_query
args.desc: A SQL query string; table name is data

args.name: [has_headers]
args.desc: TRUE (default): first row holds column names; FALSE: auto-generate Col1..ColN

functions.desc: SQL with 2 tables 'data' + 'extra'. Example: SELECT a.*, b.x FROM data a JOIN extra b ON a.ID=b.ID

args.name: join_table
args.desc: A second range to join with the data table

args.name: sql_query
args.desc: A SQL query string; table name is data

args.name: [has_headers]
args.desc: TRUE (default): first row holds column names; FALSE: auto-generate Col1..ColN

functions.expr: { var t = new Dictionary<string, object[,]> { ["extra"] = InputNormalizer.NormalizeTo2D(extra)! }; return SqlCore.SqlQuery(InputNormalizer.NormalizeTo2D(data)!, InputNormalizer.ToString(sql), t, InputNormalizer.ToBool(hh, true))!; }

args.name: table1

args.desc: Second data range for multi-table SQL
